0a7e6792-9282-4d83-9df9-771e8b9c0af3.sentence: If a poll job evaluates a watch and the trigger gate returns false, then the poll evaluator shall record the observation and reschedule the next poll without emitting an agent_run.
0a7e6792-9282-4d83-9df9-771e8b9c0af3.systemResponse: record the observation and reschedule the next poll without emitting an agent_run
0a7e6792-9282-4d83-9df9-771e8b9c0af3.trigger: a poll job evaluates a watch and the trigger gate returns false
0a7e6792-9282-4d83-9df9-771e8b9c0af3.verificationNote: N cheap poll jobs produce zero-to-M agent runs.

1c624964-d3f1-44f0-a008-114a75824eb5.sentence: The poll evaluator shall suppress the run when the observation hash equals the previous observation hash or the cooldown has not elapsed.
1c624964-d3f1-44f0-a008-114a75824eb5.systemResponse: suppress the run when the observation hash equals the previous observation hash or the cooldown has not elapsed
1c624964-d3f1-44f0-a008-114a75824eb5.verificationNote: Mirrors the pure should_trigger gate in domain/watches.py.

292972f5-61cd-408d-a6ca-fa136a006375.preCondition: a one-time deferred run must remain editable or cancellable before it fires
292972f5-61cd-408d-a6ca-fa136a006375.sentence: Where a one-time deferred run must remain editable or cancellable before it fires, the run service shall represent the one-time deferred run as a once schedule row rather than a directly deferred job.
292972f5-61cd-408d-a6ca-fa136a006375.systemResponse: represent the one-time deferred run as a once schedule row rather than a directly deferred job
292972f5-61cd-408d-a6ca-fa136a006375.verificationNote: Table-first when a pending run is a managed thing.

29523a0e-56d9-4ad5-81de-4a681bdce6c3.sentence: The agent_watch table shall act as a condition-gated run-emitting contract parallel to agent_schedule, emitting a run only when its deterministic gate passes.
29523a0e-56d9-4ad5-81de-4a681bdce6c3.systemResponse: act as a condition-gated run-emitting contract parallel to agent_schedule, emitting a run only when its deterministic gate passes
29523a0e-56d9-4ad5-81de-4a681bdce6c3.verificationNote: Second factory: clock-gated vs condition-gated, same emit-a-run shape.

336c207b-6459-4bd8-81b1-aa382fe6964f.sentence: If a run birth repeats a previously used pair of trigger type and trigger id, then the run service shall return the existing run without creating a duplicate.
336c207b-6459-4bd8-81b1-aa382fe6964f.systemResponse: return the existing run without creating a duplicate
336c207b-6459-4bd8-81b1-aa382fe6964f.trigger: a run birth repeats a previously used pair of trigger type and trigger id
336c207b-6459-4bd8-81b1-aa382fe6964f.verificationNote: Replayed deliveries and re-fired occurrences are no-ops.

3a3f9631-68a3-48a7-842f-0437ef67f867.sentence: The run service shall bound concurrent on-demand execution by worker count and per-process concurrency rather than by ingress rate.
3a3f9631-68a3-48a7-842f-0437ef67f867.systemResponse: bound concurrent on-demand execution by worker count and per-process concurrency rather than by ingress rate
3a3f9631-68a3-48a7-842f-0437ef67f867.verificationNote: Backpressure lives in the queue, not in the ingress adapter.

417d3f8b-877e-4604-b616-864d71b531b8.preCondition: a one-time deferred run is fire-and-forget
417d3f8b-877e-4604-b616-864d71b531b8.sentence: Where a one-time deferred run is fire-and-forget, the run service shall defer the job directly with a future scheduled execution time and omit the schedule row.
417d3f8b-877e-4604-b616-864d71b531b8.systemResponse: defer the job directly with a future scheduled execution time and omit the schedule row
417d3f8b-877e-4604-b616-864d71b531b8.verificationNote: Direct-defer with schedule_at when a pending run is not managed.

43d1c3f0-f5a1-40ed-a4ae-85bcc97e61f6.sentence: When a once schedule reaches its firing horizon, the schedule materializer shall emit one agent_run with trigger type deferred and then disable the schedule row.
43d1c3f0-f5a1-40ed-a4ae-85bcc97e61f6.systemResponse: emit one agent_run with trigger type deferred and then disable the schedule row
43d1c3f0-f5a1-40ed-a4ae-85bcc97e61f6.trigger: a once schedule reaches its firing horizon
43d1c3f0-f5a1-40ed-a4ae-85bcc97e61f6.verificationNote: One-shot fires once, then the row is disabled.

4805bca2-c668-44fa-9489-9145faad37f3.sentence: The run service shall route each deferred run through Procrastinate for queue placement, per-conversation locking, and worker concurrency, regardless of birth path.
4805bca2-c668-44fa-9489-9145faad37f3.systemResponse: route each deferred run through Procrastinate for queue placement, per-conversation locking, and worker concurrency, regardless of birth path
4805bca2-c668-44fa-9489-9145faad37f3.verificationNote: Birth and governance are independent axes; on-demand is governed too.

61e7f6d0-7f60-453f-b89f-507957848b79.sentence: The agent worker shall treat the run job as non-retryable and mark a stalled run interrupted rather than replaying the agent turn.
61e7f6d0-7f60-453f-b89f-507957848b79.systemResponse: treat the run job as non-retryable and mark a stalled run interrupted rather than replaying the agent turn
61e7f6d0-7f60-453f-b89f-507957848b79.verificationNote: Agent turns are non-idempotent; the reconciler chooses the resume policy.

71d3d6d5-8a87-498d-ba19-b8a13681c878.sentence: When an enabled interval schedule reaches a firing instant, the schedule materializer shall emit one agent_run with trigger type recurring and advance next_fire_at in the schedule's IANA timezone.
71d3d6d5-8a87-498d-ba19-b8a13681c878.systemResponse: emit one agent_run with trigger type recurring and advance next_fire_at in the schedule's IANA timezone
71d3d6d5-8a87-498d-ba19-b8a13681c878.trigger: an enabled interval schedule reaches a firing instant
71d3d6d5-8a87-498d-ba19-b8a13681c878.verificationNote: Interval sibling of the cron firing rule; same recurring emission and re-arm.

7747e2d3-2e85-487d-8095-18a3f4cbaba7.sentence: The schedule materializer shall record one schedule_occurrence per schedule id, revision, and scheduled instant, and skip emission when that occurrence already exists.
7747e2d3-2e85-487d-8095-18a3f4cbaba7.systemResponse: record one schedule_occurrence per schedule id, revision, and scheduled instant, and skip emission when that occurrence already exists
7747e2d3-2e85-487d-8095-18a3f4cbaba7.verificationNote: The anti-duplication ledger between schedule and run; safe under replicas and restarts.

77faad29-2622-4390-bf30-47da080a60a7.sentence: The schedule materializer shall not execute agent runs itself.
77faad29-2622-4390-bf30-47da080a60a7.verificationNote: The factory only mints rows and defers jobs; the worker executes.

7922d3e1-5467-4921-812a-d30bc5481642.sentence: When an on-demand run is born, the run service shall set the run trigger type to the value identifying the ingress source.
7922d3e1-5467-4921-812a-d30bc5481642.systemResponse: set the run trigger type to the value identifying the ingress source
7922d3e1-5467-4921-812a-d30bc5481642.verificationNote: slack for Bolt ingress, api for HTTP or MCP ingress.

7e711e21-66f5-4f5e-931c-77ab2d69a261.sentence: When an agent worker claims a run, the agent worker shall acquire the conversation lock, drive one top-level stateful agent-client query, and apply the WAIT policy until the background task tree is terminal.
7e711e21-66f5-4f5e-931c-77ab2d69a261.systemResponse: acquire the conversation lock, drive one top-level stateful agent-client query, and apply the WAIT policy until the background task tree is terminal
7e711e21-66f5-4f5e-931c-77ab2d69a261.trigger: an agent worker claims a run
7e711e21-66f5-4f5e-931c-77ab2d69a261.verificationNote: The single spine all birth paths converge on; stateful client, not the one-shot helper.

84593ade-746e-4b95-a753-01ec470e3986.sentence: The run service shall not fold recurring scheduling state into the agent_run row.
84593ade-746e-4b95-a753-01ec470e3986.systemResponse: fold recurring scheduling state into the agent_run row
84593ade-746e-4b95-a753-01ec470e3986.verificationNote: A run is a single billed execution, not a live template.

85c625bd-7aed-4805-bb40-a2100ccec9f7.sentence: The run service shall record each agent execution as one agent_run row that carries the run state machine, regardless of whether the run was born on demand or emitted by a factory.
85c625bd-7aed-4805-bb40-a2100ccec9f7.systemResponse: record each agent execution as one agent_run row that carries the run state machine, regardless of whether the run was born on demand or emitted by a factory
85c625bd-7aed-4805-bb40-a2100ccec9f7.verificationNote: One execution table. No alternate run representation; birth path is provenance, not a different aggregate.

8867f192-8b9d-435e-a737-df8b4f3acdb5.sentence: When an on-demand message is accepted, the ingress adapter shall persist the accepted run as a queued row and return before the run executes.
8867f192-8b9d-435e-a737-df8b4f3acdb5.systemResponse: persist the accepted run as a queued row and return before the run executes
8867f192-8b9d-435e-a737-df8b4f3acdb5.verificationNote: Fast acknowledgement; a burst becomes durable queued rows instantly.

9a489d08-2319-48cd-b8f3-cb9494176596.sentence: When an enabled cron schedule reaches a firing instant, the schedule materializer shall emit one agent_run with trigger type recurring and advance next_fire_at in the schedule's IANA timezone.
9a489d08-2319-48cd-b8f3-cb9494176596.systemResponse: emit one agent_run with trigger type recurring and advance next_fire_at in the schedule's IANA timezone
9a489d08-2319-48cd-b8f3-cb9494176596.trigger: an enabled cron schedule reaches a firing instant
9a489d08-2319-48cd-b8f3-cb9494176596.verificationNote: Recurring schedule stays enabled and re-arms.

ae13296f-7790-4332-bc4d-a0d26a780154.sentence: The agent_run table shall enforce idempotent birth through a unique constraint on trigger type and trigger id.
ae13296f-7790-4332-bc4d-a0d26a780154.systemResponse: enforce idempotent birth through a unique constraint on trigger type and trigger id
ae13296f-7790-4332-bc4d-a0d26a780154.verificationNote: slack event id, occurrence key, and watch hash all land here.

be4e837b-5cd2-4663-9613-eea32169be29.sentence: When an ingress adapter accepts an on-demand message, the run service shall create the agent_run directly and defer its Procrastinate job in the same transaction without creating an agent_schedule row.
be4e837b-5cd2-4663-9613-eea32169be29.systemResponse: create the agent_run directly and defer its Procrastinate job in the same transaction without creating an agent_schedule row
be4e837b-5cd2-4663-9613-eea32169be29.trigger: an ingress adapter accepts an on-demand message
be4e837b-5cd2-4663-9613-eea32169be29.verificationNote: On-demand skips the factory entirely; mirrors accept_slack_message.

d3c8ddb0-c906-4e3f-8547-5277c30248ee.sentence: The agent_schedule table shall act as a thin run-emitting contract that stores a run template and a firing rule and carries no run execution state.
d3c8ddb0-c906-4e3f-8547-5277c30248ee.systemResponse: act as a thin run-emitting contract that stores a run template and a firing rule and carries no run execution state
d3c8ddb0-c906-4e3f-8547-5277c30248ee.verificationNote: Template + clock, not an execution. One schedule maps to many runs.

d93c4be9-8f11-4834-94d2-b89f542a1c61.sentence: When a poll job evaluates a watch and the deterministic trigger gate returns true, the poll evaluator shall emit one agent_run with trigger type poll.
d93c4be9-8f11-4834-94d2-b89f542a1c61.systemResponse: emit one agent_run with trigger type poll
d93c4be9-8f11-4834-94d2-b89f542a1c61.trigger: a poll job evaluates a watch and the deterministic trigger gate returns true
d93c4be9-8f11-4834-94d2-b89f542a1c61.verificationNote: The expensive agent run fires only when the cheap gate passes.

e40c0e00-c209-473e-ac82-5ae4597e2c2a.sentence: When runs for distinct conversations are queued, the agent workers shall execute the runs concurrently up to the configured per-process concurrency.
e40c0e00-c209-473e-ac82-5ae4597e2c2a.systemResponse: execute the runs concurrently up to the configured per-process concurrency
e40c0e00-c209-473e-ac82-5ae4597e2c2a.trigger: runs for distinct conversations are queued
e40c0e00-c209-473e-ac82-5ae4597e2c2a.verificationNote: Distinct conversations parallelize; same conversation serializes.

e66c5ef3-3edc-4152-8a57-1b26032b3558.sentence: The run service shall assign runs that share a conversation the Procrastinate lock keyed on the conversation id so they execute sequentially.
e66c5ef3-3edc-4152-8a57-1b26032b3558.systemResponse: assign runs that share a conversation the Procrastinate lock keyed on the conversation id so they execute sequentially
e66c5ef3-3edc-4152-8a57-1b26032b3558.verificationNote: Invariant: one active run per conversation; serializes the stateful client per session.

waivers.reason: Architectural requirements name concrete singular components (a run, a schedule row, the conversation lock); indefinite articles are correct domain prose, not ambiguity.
Compound responses (queue placement AND locking AND concurrency) describe one atomic governance act on the same subject; splitting them would fragment a single invariant.
Pronouns (its, itself) refer unambiguously to the single system subject of the requirement; no cross-entity referent exists.
Enumerations of trigger types / birth paths are domain vocabulary, not logical operators needing decomposition.
Temporal words (before it fires, until terminal, then disable) encode the actual firing/lifecycle ordering this spec exists to pin; they are load-bearing, not vague.
Leaf goals TX-G1..G3 are architectural framing verified by inspection; their derived children carry the testable obligations.
Non-goal requirements (materializer shall not execute; run shall not fold in schedule state) are intentionally negated boundary statements.
WAIT and IANA are defined terms in docs/architecture/reference.md (§2.2 WAIT policy; §11 IANA timezone); this spec extends that document's vocabulary rather than redefining it.
